verdict.rationale: Ramp ships in-product AI (Ramp Intelligence and Ramp agents), so whether customers can stop their data from being used to train AI models is a fair question for this product. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a training opt-out, a no-training commitment, or any data-use policy for model training. The scope controls, MCP access restrictions and audit logs cover access to data, not training use, so they earn no credit here.
